name: AI Addendum
description: Common Paper standard AI Addendum covering provider-supplied AI Services in a product, including permitted uses, restrictions, model training limitations, and non-training improvement rights.

name: Business Associate Agreement
description: Common Paper standard Business Associate Agreement for HIPAA-covered arrangements, setting out business associate obligations, permitted uses and disclosures of PHI, safeguards, and assessments.

name: Cloud Service Agreement
description: Common Paper standard Cloud Service Agreement governing access to and use of a cloud service, including support, user accounts, customer content, feedback and usage data, fees, and data protection.

name: Data Processing Agreement
description: Common Paper Data Processing Agreement addressing processor and subprocessor relationships, processing instructions, data subject requests, security measures, and international transfers.

name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement Cover Page
description: Cover page for the Common Paper Mutual NDA, used to record transaction-specific terms and to incorporate the MNDA Standard Terms by reference.

name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement Standard Terms
description: Common Paper Mutual NDA standard terms establishing mutual confidentiality obligations between two parties exchanging confidential information.

name: Partnership Agreement
description: Common Paper standard Partnership Agreement for commercial collaborations, covering each party's obligations, payment and taxes, intellectual property, confidentiality, warranties, and liability.

name: Pilot Agreement
description: Common Paper standard Pilot Agreement for time-boxed evaluation deployments of a product, covering pilot access, software licenses, user accounts, customer content, and feedback.

name: Software License Agreement
description: Common Paper standard Software License Agreement covering installation and use of on-premises or hosted software, including license scope, user accounts, machine learning usage, open source software, and support.

name: Design Partner Agreement
description: Common Paper standard Design Partner Agreement granting a partner early access to a pre-release product in exchange for structured feedback and participation in a design partner program.

name: Professional Services Agreement
description: Common Paper standard Professional Services Agreement for consulting and services engagements governed by statements of work, covering providing services, change orders, acceptance, subcontractors, and fees.

name: Service Level Agreement
description: Common Paper Service Level Agreement defining target uptime, uptime calculation, response times, remedies such as service credits, and exclusions for a cloud service.
